Ask about the scope, their credentials, Chinese or interpreters, fees, and whether follow-up evidence and the interview are included. "Guaranteed to pass" is not a USCIS decision.

加州社会服务部：SSI/SSP: California Department of Social Services: SSI/SSP
SSP 是加州在 SSI 之上另加的州补助，两项都由 SSA 发放。: SSP is California's state payment on top of SSI; SSA pays both.
SSA 在 2026 年 10 月公布了 2027 年的数字。2026 年的数字: SSA published the 2027 figures in October 2026. The 2026 figures still apply through the end of 2026, so keep the two years apart.
生活费调整（COLA）：2026 年 2.8%；2027 年 3.6%。社安金从: Cost-of-living adjustment (COLA): 2.8% in 2026; 3.6% in 2027. Social Security rises with benefits payable in January 2027; the SSI increase starts with the payment on December 31, 2026.
工作积分：2026 年每 $1,890 受保收入记 1 个；2027 年每 $1: Work credits: one per $1,890 of covered earnings in 2026; one per $1,970 in 2027. You can earn at most 4 a year, and retirement still takes 40.
SSI 联邦标准（每月最多）：2026 年个人 $994、夫妻 $1,491；2: SSI federal payment standard (monthly maximum): $994 for an individual and $1,491 for a couple in 2026; $1,029 and $1,544 in 2027. The resource limit is the same in both years: $2,000 for an individual, $3,000 for a couple.
加州的 SSP 是州政府在 SSI 之上另加的补助，由 SSA 一起发放；它的金: California's SSP is a state payment added on top of SSI, paid by SSA along with it; its amount is not part of the federal standard above, and SSA works out what you personally receive each month.
还没到完全退休年龄又在工作：全年收入限制 2026 年 $24,480、2027: Working before full retirement age: the yearly earnings limit is $24,480 in 2026 and $25,560 in 2027, and SSA withholds $1 of benefits for every $2 above it. In the year you reach full retirement age, the limit for the months before that month is $65,160 in 2026 and $67,920 in 2027, with $1 withheld for every $3 above it; from the month you reach full retirement age there is no limit.
缴社安税的工资上限：2026 年 $184,500，2027 年 $192,30: Earnings subject to Social Security tax: up to $184,500 in 2026 and $192,300 in 2027; the Medicare tax has no such limit.
